newsitem.title: POLAND: Salomon sees Polish T-bill yields rising in March.
newsitem.headline: Salomon sees Polish T-bill yields rising in March.

text.p: Rising budget financing needs this month are likely to push Polish T-bill yields up in the next few weeks, Salomon Brothers in London said in a report.

In a report dated March 6, Salomon analyst Miranda Xafa said T-bill rates were likely to rise after lagging the 300-basis point increase in money market rates since December, which was triggered by tighter monetary policy.

"The T-bill rates have not followed the increase in money market rates because seasonally low borrowing requirements in December-February have permitted the Treasury to accept only a small proportion of submitted bids," the report said.
"However, rising financing needs in March probably will put upward pressure on T-bill rates, which will probably rise from the current 20.9 percent in coming weeks," it added.
